rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the best or most desirable option.

example.english: Going in the morning is ideal because there are fewer people.
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 heoi3 jan4 siu2 di1 zeoi3 lei5 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something has no flaws or defects, rather than merely being the best option.

example.english: This report is flawless—it’s ideal, with not a single typo.
example.traditional: 呢份報告真係完美，一個錯字都冇。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan1 hai6 jyun4 mei5 jat1 go3 co3 zi6 dou1 mou5
